column1: # GENERATED by src/bin/gen_fof2_grid.rs from fof2::climatology_fof2. Do not edit by
# hand: the test fof2::tests::bundled_grid_matches_its_generator compares the two.
# THESE ARE NOT CCIR, URSI OR IRI COEFFICIENTS. The layout follows the operational
# maps (latitude x local solar time, per season, at two solar-activity levels
# interpolated in NmF2) so that real coefficient data drops in as a file
# replacement, but the values are an order-of-magnitude climatology calibrated only
# to fof2::fof2_from_ssn. See the provenance section of fof2's module docs.
# Columns: season, ssn, latitude_deg, then foF2 at local solar time
# 0, 1, ... 23 h. Season is the LOCAL season (already hemisphere-flipped by the
# caller), so a row's latitude sign carries no seasonal meaning.
# Lattice: 37 latitude rows from -90 deg at 5 deg, 24 local-time columns at 1 h (periodic).
